relationships.subject: simvastatin
relationships.evidence_quote: All tested statins (simvastatin, atorvastatin and rosuvastatin) activate human TRPA1 and, in addition, simvastatin activates human TRPV1 and rosuvastatin activates human TRPM8.

relationships.subject: atorvastatin
relationships.evidence_quote: All tested statins (simvastatin, atorvastatin and rosuvastatin) activate human TRPA1 and, in addition, simvastatin activates human TRPV1 and rosuvastatin activates human TRPM8.

relationships.subject: rosuvastatin
relationships.evidence_quote: All tested statins (simvastatin, atorvastatin and rosuvastatin) activate human TRPA1 and, in addition, simvastatin activates human TRPV1 and rosuvastatin activates human TRPM8.

relationships.subject: simvastatin
relationships.evidence_quote: The activation of TRPV1 by simvastatin is abolished in a capsaicin-insensitive mutant.

relationships.subject: rosuvastatin
relationships.evidence_quote: In addition, TRPM8 plays an important role for the activation of a small population of DRG neurons by rosuvastatin.

relationships.subject: simvastatin
relationships.evidence_quote: In mouse dorsal root ganglion (DRG) neurons, simvastatin activates a subpopulation of neurons which also respond to the TRPV1-agonist capsaicin or the TRPA1-agonist allyl isothiocyanate.

key_findings: Simvastatin, atorvastatin and rosuvastatin activate human TRPA1; simvastatin also activates TRPV1 and rosuvastatin TRPM8.
Simvastatin activates a subpopulation of mouse DRG neurons overlapping with capsaicin/AITC responders.
